claim_scores.rationale: Creates `dspy.LM('openai/test-model', cache=False, temperature=0.7, max_tokens=100)` and later inspects `lm.kwargs`, matching the stored defaults requirement.
Patches `litellm.completion` directly, which is the chat LM path reached through `litellm_completion`.
First call uses `temperature=0.1, max_tokens=5`, and the first captured request is asserted to contain exactly those override values.
Second call has no override, and the second captured request is asserted to use the original defaults `(100, 0.7)`.
Asserts `lm.kwargs['max_tokens'] == 100` and `lm.kwargs['temperature'] == 0.7`, showing no client mutation after overrides.
`FakeChatResponse` provides `choices` entries with `finish_reason`, so DSPy's truncation check can run in this mocked example.
